title: Cross-Asset Knowledge Transfer for Early Fault Detection of Data-Scarce Assets Without Target Fault Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.06194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliability management of industrial fleets depends on early fault warnings, yet lifecycle data across similar assets are highly imbalanced. A few assets accumulate run-to-failure histories, while newly installed or rarely failing assets provide only normal-condition data. This paper asks how diagnostic knowledge can be transferred from a data-rich source asset to a data-scarce target asset when no fault data have been observed on the target. We formulate cross-asset early fault detection as a zero-shot domain adaptation problem, in which zero-shot refers to the absence of target fault samples, and propose a framework that requires only normal data from the target. The framework comprises (1) a statistical process control step that labels the source asset run-to-failure data with an exponentially weighted moving average chart, reducing manual annotation to verifying flagged segments, (2) an Adapted Domain-Adversarial Neural Network (ADAN

translated_title: 面向无目标故障数据的数据稀缺资产的跨资产知识迁移早期故障检测方法
translated_abstract: 工业机队的可靠性管理依赖于早期故障预警，然而相似资产之间的生命周期数据高度不平衡。少数资产积累了从运行到失效的完整历史数据，而新安装的或很少发生故障的资产仅能提供正常工况下的数据。本文研究的问题是：当目标资产上尚未观测到任何故障数据时，如何将诊断知识从数据丰富的源资产迁移到数据稀缺的目标资产。我们将跨资产早期故障检测形式化为一个零样本域适应问题，其中“零样本”指的是目标资产故障样本的缺失，并提出一个仅需目标资产正常数据的框架。该框架包含：(1) 一个统计过程控制步骤，利用指数加权移动平均（EWMA）控制图对源资产的运行至失效数据进行自动标注，将人工标注工作简化为对被标记片段的验证；(2) 一个改进的域对抗神经网络（ADAN……
tldr: 本文提出一个零样本域适应框架，在目标资产完全没有故障数据的情况下，仅利用其正常数据即可通过EWMA自动标注源资产数据并借助改进的域对抗神经网络实现跨资产早期故障检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a zero-shot domain adaptation framework that enables early fault detection for data-scarce assets without any target fault data by automatically labeling source asset data via EWMA control charts and transferring diagnostic knowledge through an Adapted Domain-Adversarial Neural Network.
